newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain busts key drugs ring, arrests five.
newsitem.headline: Spain busts key drugs ring, arrests five.

text.p: Spanish authorities said on Tuesday they had broken one of the most important illicit tobacco and drugs rings in Spain, arresting five people and seizing three tons of hashish.

As part of a five-month operation, Spanish officials said customs officers had seized hashish valued at nine billion pesetas ($60 million) in the early hours of Tuesday on the northeastern coast near Vigo.
Among those arrested was leading narcotics trafficker Laureano Oubina, authorities said.
"After five months of investigations, one of the most important networks of illicit tobacco and drugs in Spain has been dismantled," a government official said.
